connector.name: OpenResearch MCP
connector.registryDescription: Zero-auth research MCP: web, academic, finance, news, weather, macro, social, SEC. No keys.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package openresearch-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the olanokhin account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
